name: Steffi Nossen SummerDance Camps
description_short: Week long dance camps for rising 1st to 5th graders at the Steffi Nossen studio in White Plains, with daily technique classes, dance making and a studio performance each Friday. Weeks cover general dance, movie themed dance and musical theater; no experience needed.
refund_policy_summary: Tuition is non-refundable, with no refunds or credits for missed classes.
notes: Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 3:30 pm. Sibling discount 10% off the 2nd child and 5% off the 3rd; multi week discount 10% off the 2nd week and 5% off the 3rd. The school also runs Storybook Camp (ages 3 to 5) and Summer Intensives (grades 6 to 8) on separate pages.
